jobs.occupation: Expert Project Planning & Scheduling (m/f/d) (Projektingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The first 8 weeks of any given project are considered the most critical and crucial for the initialization of the project and the successful execution of the same. To help the BUs and the RAs organizations, it has been decided to create a new group that will be mainly focused on executing the project setup, ensuring the needed infrastructures, software, systems, procedures and tools are correctly implemented to guarantee a consistent and structured project delivery approach, in line with contractual requirements and Client's expectations.
The Expert Project Planning & Scheduling (m/f/d) is expected to initiate the project planning and contribute to its successful execution. This includes preparing, monitoring, and ensuring compliance with all planning and scheduling requirements to meet client expectations and contractual obligations.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Prepare project planning and scheduling tools and track the delivery of key inputs.
- Implement all tools in accordance with corporate requirements (mandatory tools) and ensure a corporate-compliant planning and scheduling setup, including the project master schedule and the progress measurement system.
- Align planning and scheduling systems with the company's information requirements (e.g., SAP).
- Develop all necessary documentation and procedures for the implementation of the aforementioned tools and systems.
- Ensure that the planning systems are set up according to the standardized WBS structure and are configured to exchange data with oneERP.

Show your expertise

- Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, or Project Management, coupled with several years of relevant operational experience in the construction industry.
- Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of project planning and the proven ability to analyze technical documents effectively.
- Skilled in introducing new methodologies and techniques in planning, with a strong track record of working collaboratively with internal teams and external consultants.
- Proven experience in ensuring all planning systems align with company information requirements like SAP and are set up according to standardized WBS structures, enhancing data exchange with systems such as oneERP.
- Fluent in English with German being a significant plus. You also exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills and proactive behavior, essential for successful team and client interactions.

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through eGym Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

Demonstrated ability to define and execute successful Go-to-Market strategies.- Awareness of how AI and emerging technologies are reshaping energy management, with the ability to translate these trends into portfolio and Go-to-Market decisions.- Experience applying AI-driven insights to portfolio strategy or Go-to-Market planning is a strong differentiator.- Ability to identify and pursue opportunities beyond existing portfolio boundaries, transforming market insights into actionable initiatives.

You take initiative, contribute your own ideas, and aren't afraid to put them into practice.- Long-term experience within large corporations is a plus.
- Languages: Fluent in English and conversational in German; additional languages are a plus.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
The transition to a sustainable, carbon-neutral future is reshaping the energy, building, and industrial process industries at an unprecedented pace. Renewable energy, storage solutions, and the accelerating electrification of transport and industrial processes are placing new and complex demands on the power grids of tomorrow.
As ONE Tech Company, Siemens is more than the sum of its parts — and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition. We are aligning product and portfolio elements across our businesses, harmonizing our energy management offerings, and building a coherent go-to-market strategy that reflects the full strength of Siemens. High-visibility, cross-functional, and genuinely impactful — this is the role for someone ready to shape the future of energy management from within.
One team. One goal.
In the Chief Technology Office's Digital Portfolio team, we bring together product and portfolio managers, customers, and sales specialists to do one thing exceptionally well: transform our digital products and services so our customers can thrive in the energy transition. Smarter grids. Greener manufacturing. More sustainable buildings and neighborhoods. That is what we are here to build — together.
The technical foundation is there — now we need the right person to bring it all together. We are looking for an experienced professional who can harmonize and lead our go-to-market strategy across existing and new energy management offerings, building a compelling and unified market presence for Siemens. As our "ONE Tech Company Energy Management" Portfolio Manager, you will be the connector — bridging Siemens businesses, fostering collaboration, and driving the technical alignment of our portfolio.

At Siemens, ownership is not a title — it is a mindset. Every employee takes personal responsibility for our success. We empower our leaders to act as owners, make bold decisions, and innovate to win. We communicate with openness and honesty, learn from what does not work, and celebrate what does. We recognize achievements — individual and collective — and we invest seriously in the growth of our people.

To transform the everyday, you need to think outside the box. That’s why we at Siemens are looking for innovators who aren’t afraid to push boundaries to join our diverse team of tech experts. Got what it takes? Then help us create lasting, positive change!

jobs.occupation: Sales Director (f/m/d) Test & Validation - DACH (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.

Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

What You Bring

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The primary locations for this opportunity are Austria, Germany, and Switzerland. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
Austria: €162,200 – €308,300
Germany: €145,500 – €291,000

Switzerland: CHF 249,900 – CHF 437,200

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation with 50% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.
